message.content:
This magazine cover features a large illustration of a man hanging upside down from a crane hook. The man is wearing a light-colored, long-sleeved shirt with straps along the back and dark trousers. His legs are tied together at the ankles with thick rope and suspended from a grey metal hook attached to a thin vertical cable. He is depicted in a vertical orientation with his head near the bottom and feet at the top. The man’s facial expression is neutral.

The background is plain white with a red vertical border on the left and a red horizontal border at the bottom. Large red block letters across the top spell "TEMPO." Other black text includes "JUNGKIR BALIK R.J. LINO," "4-10 JANUARI 2016," "BUKTI-BUKTI KRIMINALISASI NOVEL BASWEDAN," "FILM PILIHAN TEMPO 2015," and a smaller paragraph below the main headline. At the bottom left, there is a barcode, the price "RP 39.500," the website "WWW.TEMPO.CO," and other publication details. A small, multicolored logo sits near the top left corner.
